coachingInstructions.missedSession: Skip or move one session only if the next key session and recovery still fit. Do not stack missed quality, heavy work or long runs. After two missed sessions, illness or a week away, review the next block.
coachingInstructions.liftingEffort: Warm up to the prescribed effort. RPE governs the suggested kg. If effort overshoots by a point, reduce 2.5–5% and reassess; if still excessive, omit remaining back-offs. Heavy singles are skill practice, not forced maximal attempts.
coachingInstructions.speedWork: Accelerate with stable technique. Reduce load or stop when speed or position deteriorates. An easy speed day is not permission to turn it into a heavy day.
coachingInstructions.athleteJudgement: Report sustained fatigue, sleep disruption, pain, illness or altered movement. End the provoking work when needed. One difficult session is a reason to adjust that session, not an automatic full deload.
coachingInstructions.review: Review completed work every four weeks and after events. Later blocks are conditional on observed recovery and performance; no race result or lifting total is guaranteed.
